evidence.location: §2 LR1 lines 146-152; LR1-C1 line 219; H2 line 95
evidence.observation: The plan writes the documented steps as "run `gnd verify … --format json`" and LR1-C1 requires that "the documented steps give exactly one failing constraint". Reproducing H2 at this checkout shows an unstated precondition: `reading.orm.json` names an include `{path: "vocabulary.orm.json", sha256: 25ac1974…}`, and `gnd verify` resolves that include relative to the current working directory, not the model file's directory. Run from the repository root, `gnd verify src/gnd/examples/literature/reading_fixture/reading.orm.json <run>/reported-conflict.population.json --no-extraction --format json` exits 3 with `outcome: ill_formed` and issue `include:unreadable` at `$.includes`; only when run from a directory containing `vocabulary.orm.json` does it exit 1 `violated` exactly as H2 states. The example itself works only because it stages both files into its working folder (src/gnd/examples/literature/reading.py:384-385). Left unaddressed, the LR1 page and the LR1-C1 test as planned would hit exit 3 on the packaged fixture.

concerns.recommendation: Add one line to the plan (§2 LR1 or §3 Fixtures) stating that the documented steps and the LR1 test must stage the model with its include — `reading.orm.json` beside `vocabulary.orm.json`, run from that folder — so the page and LR1-C1 are measurable as written.
concerns.title: LR1's documented verify steps omit the model-include staging the probe requires
